1.web: For you yourselves know, brothers, our visit to you wasn’t in vain,
1.asv: For yourselves, brethren, know our entering in unto you, that it hath not been found vain:

2.web: but having suffered before and been shamefully treated, as you know, at Philippi, we grew bold in our God to tell you the Good News of God in much conflict.
2.asv: but having suffered before and been shamefully treated, as ye know, at Philippi, we waxed bold in our God to speak unto you the gospel of God in much conflict.

3.web: For our exhortation is not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in deception.
3.asv: For our exhortation is not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in guile:

4.web: But even as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the Good News, so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, who tests our hearts.
4.asv: but even as we have been approved of God to be intrusted with the gospel, so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God who proveth our hearts.

5.web: For neither were we at any time found using words of flattery, as you know, nor a cloak of covetousness (God is witness),
5.asv: For neither at any time were we found using words of flattery, as ye know, nor a cloak of covetousness, God is witness;

6.web: nor seeking glory from men (neither from you nor from others), when we might have claimed authority as apostles of Christ.
6.asv: nor seeking glory of men, neither from you nor from others, when we might have claimed authority as apostles of Christ.

7.web: But we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother cherishes her own children.
7.asv: But we were gentle in the midst of you, as when a nurse cherisheth her own children:

8.web: Even so, affectionately longing for you, we were well pleased to impart to you, not the Good News of God only, but also our own souls, because you had become very dear to us.
8.asv: even so, being affectionately desirous of you, we were well pleased to impart unto you, not the gospel of God only, but also our own souls, because ye were become very dear to us.

9.web: For you remember, brothers, our labor and travail; for working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we preached to you the Good News of God.
9.asv: For ye remember, brethren, our labor and travail: working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we preached unto you the gospel of God.

10.web: You are witnesses with God, how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.
10.asv: Ye are witnesses, and God also, how holily and righteously and unblamably we behaved ourselves toward you that believe:

11.web: As you know, we exhorted, comforted, and implored every one of you, as a father does his own children,
11.asv: as ye know how we dealt with each one of you, as a father with his own children, exhorting you, and encouraging you, and testifying,

12.web: to the end that you should walk worthily of God, who calls you into his own Kingdom and glory.
12.asv: to the end that ye should walk worthily of God, who calleth you into his own kingdom and glory.

13.web: For this cause we also thank God without ceasing, that, when you received from us the word of the message of God, you accepted it not as the word of men, but, as it is in truth, the word of God, which also works in you who believe.
13.asv: And for this cause we also thank God without ceasing, that, when ye received from us the word of the message, even the word of God, ye accepted it not as the word of men, but, as it is in truth, the word of God, which also worketh in you that believe.

14.web: For you, brothers, became imitators of the assemblies of God which are in Judea in Christ Jesus; for you also suffered the same things from your own countrymen, even as they did from the Jews;
14.asv: For ye, brethren, became imitators of the churches of God which are in Judæa in Christ Jesus: for ye also suffered the same things of your own countrymen, even as they did of the Jews;

15.web: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out, and didn’t please God, and are contrary to all men;
15.asv: who both killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and drove out us, and please not God, and are contrary to all men;

16.web: forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved; to fill up their sins always. But wrath has come on them to the uttermost.
16.asv: forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved; to fill up their sins always: but the wrath is come upon them to the uttermost.

17.web: But we, brothers, being bereaved of you for a short season, in presence, not in heart, tried even harder to see your face with great desire,
17.asv: But we, brethren, being bereaved of you for a short season, in presence not in heart, endeavored the more exceedingly to see your face with great desire:

18.web: because we wanted to come to you—indeed, I, Paul, once and again—but Satan hindered us.
18.asv: because we would fain have come unto you, I Paul once and again; and Satan hindered us.

19.web: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Isn’t it even you, before our Lord Jesus at his coming?
19.asv: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of glorying? Are not even ye, before our Lord Jesus at his coming?

20.web: For you are our glory and our joy.
20.asv: For ye are our glory and our joy.
